When creating the game you choose a level: 🌱 Easy, ⚖️ Medium or 🎓 Realistic. Under «⚙️ More options» you can combine the mode (Quick or Realistic) and the difficulty as before: that shows as «Custom».
  • Easy: the More menu shows the basics first and opens the rest as you progress (Banks and companies at 18, the Stock exchange with savings of one year of average wage…); the «🔓» notice tells you when. In Settings you can show everything from the start.
  • First time: each important screen is explained with a short card and a «Did you know…?» with its source.
  • You should: the suggested next step appears above the map; tap it to go to the screen, or ✕ to hide it this year.
  • Your year in numbers: every year the history sums up income, expenses and how your net worth changed, and explains why.
  • Warnings: if you keep more in a risky bank than deposit insurance covers, it warns you before anything happens.
  • 📖 Glossary (More): economics and finance terms; in Easy they appear underlined on the money and country screens.

Learning in levels (scaffolding) is how almost everything is taught: first the essentials with support, then more variables and less help. That way each piece is understood before putting them together.

🌱 Easy: simple rules, more leeway and help; advanced options open up as you progress. ⚖️ Medium: real data with simple rules. 🎓 Realistic: all mechanics. Under «More options» you can combine mode and difficulty as you like.
Understanding a few words (inflation, interest, net worth) is enough to follow most economic news and make better decisions with your money.
Each term comes with a short, precise definition. In Easy mode, the terms appear underlined on the money and country screens: tap them to read it.
